lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: 11 to 12 distinct vertical white lines; spacing is relatively uniform with a slight increase in the interval between lines 5 and 6 in the mid-torso region.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: Vertical segments 4, 5, and 6 terminate abruptly at the mid-flank, failing to reach the ventral region; line 1 on the anterior shoulder is a shortened segment.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: A cluster of approximately 4 high-contrast spots is located on the posterior flank, superior to the hind limb junction.
posterior_constellation_clusters.linear_blob_alignment: Two distinct spots on the posterior flank align horizontally, creating a vector parallel to the dorsal line.

other_distinctive_markers: Visible white patch on the inner proximal foreleg; white chevron marking on the snout; white spot on the lower mandible area.
